agent_notes: Exact institution row was independently confirmed in all three supplied 2025 NIRF category pages with city Bhopal and state Madhya Pradesh.
The official CIST Introduction and Contact Us pages match the Hathaikheda, near Patel Nagar, Raisen Road, Bhopal campus.

The current central official catalogue and group homepage list six B.Tech programmes, two M.Tech programmes, and MBA with seven named specializations; no additional diploma, certificate, or doctoral programme is listed in the CIST catalogue.
The separate MBA department page contains an older narrative seat/course breakdown; the current central Programs Offered page was used for the exact programme names and specialization list.

Normal TLS first returned the documented self-signed proxy certificate-chain error. curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the confirmed NIRF, search, and corporatebpl.com hostnames; no credentials or private data were sent.
Career mappings were produced from sqlite3 read-only queries against assets/data/career_path.db; the database was not modified.
